description.value:
A frame with green crystalline inlays that dampens nearby magic.

@PPAbility[cost:1|variable:true]{Anti-Magic Targeting} Increase damage dice by 2 times the PP expended against magical foes.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Dampening Field} Create an 80-foot magic-dampening aura where spells have a 25% failure chance.

A mech can have only one starmetal frame system.
